description: Comprehensive QoL suite for Neovim: picker, explorer, dashboard, notifier, terminal, git tooling, and many workflow modules in one plugin. This schema intentionally keeps explicit <module>.enabled toggles for all exposed modules to match Snacks auto-enable conventions when module blocks are emitted.
author: folke
tagline: QoL plugins for Neovim — picker, explorer, dashboard, notifier, and 30+ more in one.

generationRules.message: Raw picker.sources overrides typed picker.sources descendants.

options.label: Enable Picker
options.description: Auto-runs picker setup on UIEnter. Disable to prevent the vim.ui.select takeover (when ui_select = true). Direct Snacks.picker.*() calls work either way.

options.label: Sort Fields
options.description: Ordering fields for picker scoring and sorting.

notices.message: Global picker filename truncation applies to all picker sources and can break source-specific behavior such as Explorer rendering. Prefer setting truncation on a specific source, for example Picker / Sources / Files / Formatters → Filename Truncation.

options.label: Input Keymaps (advanced)
options.description: Advanced key overrides for picker input window.

options.label: Picker Icons (advanced)
options.description: Override the full nested icon table for picker UI and kinds.

options.label: Per-Source Raw Override (advanced escape hatch)
options.description: Free-form Lua override for picker.sources. Use this only for things the typed per-source UI fields cannot express (custom Lua callbacks, ad-hoc keys). NOTE: if any typed picker.sources.* field below is also set, generation will FAIL with a clear error — pick one approach per source subtree.

options.label: Theme Path
options.description: Leave blank to use Snacks' default vim.fn.stdpath("cache") .. "/lazygit-theme.yml". Literal ~ paths are expanded during generation for compatibility.

options.label: Terminal Override Callback (advanced)
options.default: function(cmd, opts) return cmd, opts end

options.label: Minimum Log Level
options.description: Use vim.log.levels constants; upstream default is WARN.
options.inputPlaceholder: vim.log.levels.WARN  -- one of TRACE / DEBUG / INFO / WARN / ERROR

params.name: dirs
params.description: Lua array of directory paths, e.g. { '/path/a', '/path/b' }

params.name: finders
params.description: Lua array of finder names, e.g. { 'files', 'recent', 'buffers' }

params.name: lang
params.description: Lua array of help-tag languages, e.g. { 'en' }

functions.name: terminal_focus
functions.description: Focus terminal (or hide if already focused).
functions.label: Focus Terminal (toggle)

functions.name: notifier_notify
functions.description: Send a notification via the notifier.
functions.label: Send Notification

functions.name: git_blame_line
functions.description: Show git blame for current line.
functions.label: Show Git Blame for Current Line

functions.name: gh_open_issue
functions.luaCall: Snacks.gh.issue({ number = $params.number, repo = $params.repo, state = $params.state, mention = $params.mention, milestone = $params.milestone })
functions.label: Open GitHub Issue

functions.name: gh_open_pr
functions.luaCall: Snacks.gh.pr({ number = $params.number, repo = $params.repo, state = $params.state, draft = $params.draft, base = $params.base })
functions.label: Open GitHub Pull Request

functions.name: rename_file
functions.description: Rename current file and update references.
functions.label: Rename Current File (LSP-aware)

functions.name: meta_picker_open
functions.label: Open Meta Picker
functions.description: Open the meta picker (lists all available pickers).

functions.name: terminal_colorize
functions.label: Terminal: Colorize Buffer
functions.description: Replace ANSI color codes in the current buffer with real colors.

functions.name: notify_default
functions.label: Notify
functions.description: Show a notification at the default level.

functions.name: debug_run
functions.label: Debug: Run Buffer
functions.description: Run the current buffer (or specified buf) as Lua, showing print output inline and errors as diagnostics.

functions.name: meta_picker_dispatch
functions.label: Open Picker by Name (advanced)
functions.description: Generic dispatcher: open a picker by source name with optional opts table.

functions.name: dim_apply
functions.label: Apply Dim (one-shot)
functions.description: Dim everything outside the current scope (one-shot, distinct from enabling auto-dim).

functions.name: profiler_highlight
functions.label: Toggle Profiler Highlights (raw)
functions.description: Toggle profiler result highlights without going through Snacks.toggle.

functions.name: debug_backtrace
functions.label: Debug: Show Backtrace
functions.description: Show a notification with a pretty backtrace of the current call stack.

functionTemplates.label: Explorer (Show Hidden)
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Open file explorer with hidden files visible

functionTemplates.label: Files Picker (Neovim Config)
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Open files picker rooted at Neovim config
